Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to saving and improving lives by unlocking the power of the immune system. Our commercial product portfolio includes market-leading vaccines against smallpox, mpox, rabies, tick-borne encephalitis, typhoid fever, and cholera. We excel in R&D innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization, striving to improve people's health and quality of life worldwide, protecting our tomorrow.

We are seeking a talented Purchaser, Direct Procurement to help ensure a reliable, cost-effective supply of materials that keeps our operations running.

The role involves close collaboration with Global Procurement in Switzerland and extensive cross-functional interaction with Production, Quality, and external suppliers to drive operational excellence and secure reliable supply.

This is a fixed-term parental leave cover position until 31st December 2027.

**About The Team

**You will join a team of eight dedicated purchasing colleagues covering both direct and indirect procurement for our manufacturing site. We operate in a dynamic and fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, making adaptability and collaboration key to success. Quality is at the heart of everything we do, and we take pride in maintaining high standards while ensuring reliable supply to our operations.

As part of the team, you will experience a supportive and collaborative culture where colleagues actively help and learn from each other. We value open communication, mutual respect, and a positive team spirit, and we believe that the best results are achieved when we work together across functions and support one another in meeting both challenges and opportunities.

The role is based in our manufacturing site in Kvistgaard, Denmark and with flexibility for home office (up to 2 days). You will report to the Site Purchasing Manager.

**About The Role

**As a Purchaser within Direct Procurement, you will play a vital role in ensuring the reliable and cost-effective procurement of raw materials to support our operations. This role is hands-on and dynamic, and it offers a unique opportunity to work cross-functionally, build supplier relationships, and contribute to procurement excellence across multiple direct categories.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Issue purchase orders and ensure accurate and timely delivery of goods and services to the site

• Monitor inventory levels and maintain optimal stock levels to support operational continuity

• Identify and mitigate supply disruptions, quality issues, and supplier reliability risks

• Manage procurement activities across direct categories such as consumables, primary and secondary packaging

• Support the end-to-end requisition-to-purchase-order process in Dynamics

• Collaborate with stakeholders to align procurement with operational and business needs

• Evaluate supplier performance in alignment with internal policies

• Contribute to continuous improvement and procurement process standardization

**Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, we imagine you have:

• Experience with direct procurement or purchasing in a manufacturing or operations-driven environment

• Familiarity with ERP/procurement systems (e.g. Dynamics)

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Structured, detail-oriented approach with the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced setting

• Full proficiency in Danish and English

**What join Bavarian Nordic?

**You will join an international company with unique technology and colleagues who share a passion for making a difference. As a Purchaser, you will help keep our vaccine production running by ensuring a reliable supply of materials, building strong supplier relationships, and improving day-to-day purchasing processes.

We offer:

• A visible role with an opportunity to make an impact in a collaborative organization

• A supportive team, flexible working conditions, and opportunities to develop your procurement expertise

• A competitive compensation package, pension scheme, health insurance, and bonus opportunities

• A high-quality canteen with a wide selection of meals and take-away options

• Fitness discounts, a massage scheme, and an active staff club offering social and sporting events

**Salary

**Annual base salary range: DKK 530,000 to 620,000 gross

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The final base salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and competencies, as well as internal pay equity.

**Caught your interest?

**If you are ready to take on a pivotal role in a growing organization and drive meaningful change in healthcare, apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

Please note that for this position, we do not support any relocation packages. Candidates must possess a legal basis to work and reside in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

ValueOne is recruiting a Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport for Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS. In this newly established role, you will be responsible for driving and developing the Group's strategic procurement activities within the logistics and transportation category. The position is physically based at the Danish subsidiary's office south of Copenhagen and reports to Head of Supply Chain Operations & Development. We welcome applications from candidates residing in both Sweden and Denmark.

About Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS

Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS is one of the Nordic region's leading distributors and brand partners within food, beverages, snacks, and confectionery. With more than 100 years of experience, the Group helps both international and proprietary brands grow across the Nordic markets through strong capabilities in marketing, sales, logistics, and category development. Supply Chain is regarded as a key competitive advantage, with a strong focus on customer and brand value while ensuring the right balance between service and cost. The company currently generates annual revenues of MNOK 4500 and employs approximately 400 people across the Nordic countries. Following an acquisition in 2026, Haugen-Gruppen has also established a presence in Poland and intends to continue expanding beyond the Nordic region.

About the Role

The Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport is part of the Nordic Supply Chain team and responsible for strategic sourcing and category management at Group level within transportation, third-party logistics (3PL), warehouse equipment, packaging materials and load carriers, and, where relevant, selected third-party manufacturing. The role works closely with stakeholders across the various markets to develop competitive and sustainable supplier solutions that strengthen Haugen-Gruppen's supply chain while ensuring the right service levels and total cost position.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and develop the Group-wide Logistics & Transport category strategy.

• Lead strategic sourcing and procurement initiatives across transportation, 3PL, warehousing, and related logistics services.

• Drive the Source-to-Contract process, including sourcing strategy, tendering, negotiations, contracting, and implementation.

• Develop and optimize Route-to-Market solutions in collaboration with Supply Chain and Commercial stakeholders.

• Manage supplier relationships, commercial agreements, and performance to ensure competitiveness, service excellence, and sustainability.

• Identify cost optimization opportunities through spend analysis, market intelligence, and supplier development.

• Mitigate supplier risk and ensure compliance with Group policies, standards, and sustainability requirements.

• Support strategic sourcing initiatives across adjacent supply chain categories when required.

Experience and Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you should have:

• A Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field, alternatively equivalent relevant experience.

• Proven experience in strategic sourcing and category management managing suppliers and commercial agreements within indirect material and services.

• Strong commercial and analytical capabilities within spend analysis, tendering, negotiation, and total cost of ownership (TCO) assessment.

• Knowledge of sustainability requirements and compliance standards within logistics and procurement.

• Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language, both written and spoken.

• Experience within logistics, transportation, supply chain, or FMCG environments is considered highly advantageous.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for a proactive, accountable, analytical, and solution-oriented professional who enjoys working in an international environment. You have excellent communication and organizational skills and thrive when collaborating across functions, countries, and cultures.

A service-minded, flexible approach combined with a continuous improvement mindset will be essential for success in this role.

Application

We welcome your application for the position of Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For further information, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist James Li at James.Li@valueone.se.

About ValueOne

ValueOne specializes in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, and Logistics. We support our clients through three business areas:

• Interim Procurement and Supply Chain Consultants

• Recruitment of Procurement and Logistics Professionals

• Management Consulting

Through our consulting services, we help organizations develop and improve their procurement, logistics, and supply chain capabilities covering strategy, operating models, processes, organization, governance, and competence development.

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Are you an experienced OT SCADA professional who wants to help secure the reliable operation of business-critical systems? Would you like to apply your technical expertise in an operational technology environment supporting the future of renewable energy?

As our new OT SCADA Engineer (Integration & Operations), you will be responsible for engineering, integrating, maintaining, operating, and continuously improving SCADA systems, ensuring data flows between power plants, market-facing control applications used by BA Markets, the Operational Control Centre’s monitoring and control systems, and other data consumers underpinning Vattenfall’s business-critical renewable-energy Operational Technology applications.

You will participate in the team’s on-call rotation to support business-critical services that operate around the clock. You will help restore service during incidents and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

A key part of your role will be applying structured engineering, security and lifecycle-management principles to keep the platforms reliable, supportable and compliant with Vattenfall standards and operational requirements. You will work closely with internal colleagues, external stakeholders and suppliers.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Your role

As an OT SCADA Engineer, you will take ownership of SCADA systems and related data flows throughout their lifecycle, from initial analysis and engineering through implementation, operation, improvement and eventual replacement or decommissioning.

You will combine hands-on technical work with structured planning, documentation, and collaboration. Your focus will be on maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable SCADA systems and proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen performance, availability, and operational resilience.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Engineering, configuring, commissioning, maintaining, and improving OT SCADA solutions and interfaces for assets in operation and development.

• 
Delivering and supporting reliable data flows from plant-level systems through approved OT integration layers to monitoring, control, analytics, reporting, and data-platform consumers.

• 
Assessing site and interface readiness, identifying integration prerequisites, technical constraints, dependencies, risks and ownership boundaries, and defining requirements and integration approaches.

• 
Configuring, deploying, and supporting resilient SCADA integration components, including industrial edge devices or gateways, connectors, and data pipelines, with appropriate monitoring, troubleshooting, deployment documentation, and operational handover.

• 
Planning, estimating, and tracking assigned work, making dependencies, risks, and progress visible, and documenting and maintaining technical records and operational knowledge.

• 
Providing operational support, including incident diagnosis, service restoration, root-cause and problem analysis, defining and implementing preventive and proactive improvement actions.

• 
Participating in the team's on-call rotation, providing specialist OT SCADA support for business-critical services outside normal working hours.

• 
Improving observability and data quality through health monitoring, completeness checks, alerting, backfilling support, performance analysis, and clear operational ownership.

• 
Planning and executing lifecycle upgrades, migrations, patches, configuration changes, and component replacements using approved change and DTAP practices.

• 
Producing requirements, designs, implementation guides, configuration records, test cases, support documentation, and operational handover packages including operational runbooks, support responsibilities and escalation arrangements

• 
Supporting technical purchasing and supplier coordination through technical evaluations, solution validation, and design reviews.

• 
Preparing and executing tests and commissioning checks for assigned solutions, recording test evidence, tracking defects to resolution, and supporting factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), acceptance decisions, and operational-readiness assessments.

• 
Standardizing repeatable integration services and work packages for asset projects, while supporting refinement and estimation of less standardized initiatives.

• 
Supporting internal and external audit activities.

Your profile

You hold a relevant bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, automation or control engineering, computer engineering, technical computer science, industrial IT, or a related discipline. Alternatively, you have developed equivalent professional competence through a relevant technical qualification and substantial experience in OT SCADA engineering.

You have several years of hands-on experience engineering, integrating, and supporting SCADA systems or comparable industrial OT solutions, including responsibility for systems in operation. You thrive when taking ownership of solutions from analysis and design through to implementation, operation, and continuous improvement. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating with colleagues, suppliers, and stakeholders across the organisation. To succeed in this role, you must have excellent written and spoken English skills. The role may also be subject to security clearance, and candidates must be able to meet the applicable screening requirements.

You bring knowledge and experience in:

• SCADA systems and interfaces: configuring, integrating, commissioning, managing, maintaining, operating, and supporting SCADA applications, gateways, and interfaces connecting operational assets with central systems and data consumers.

• Industrial communications: working with relevant industrial protocols such as OPC UA, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP or MQTT, as well as APIs and vendor-specific interfaces where applicable, and diagnosing communication and integration issues.

• Operational resilience: practical understanding of high availability, service monitoring and logging, SCADA application and configuration backup and recovery, and configuration management, including dependencies on hosting and network services.

• Operational data flows: understanding signal mapping, timestamps, data quality, buffering, and the recovery of missing historical data.

• Incident and problem management: diagnosing faults across SCADA applications, interfaces, source and target systems, including dependencies on server services, networks, certificates and service accounts; restoring services; investigating root causes; and implementing preventive and proactive improvements.

• Controlled technical changes: planning and delivering upgrades, migrations and configuration changes with appropriate testing, deployment documentation, rollback arrangements and operational handover.

• Secure OT operation: applying OT security requirements, including access controls, certificate handling, system hardening and vulnerability management, within approved architectures and change procedures and in collaboration with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams.

• Engineering documentation: producing and maintaining clear technical documentation of SCADA system architectures, configurations and procedures.

• Supplier collaboration: supporting technical purchasing, assessing and validating solutions, supporting acceptance testing and coordinating technical work with colleagues and external suppliers.

Additional experience that would be valuable:

• Renewable energy, utilities or comparable industrial environments.

• OEM SCADA interfaces.

• Industrial edge platforms or gateways.

PRODUCT DEVELOPER – LIGHTING

Based in Copenhagen

Are you the Product Developer we are looking for?

We are looking for a technically skilled Product Developer who is passionate about contemporary design and has an eye for detail. You understand how to translate creative ideas into functional products without compromising the designer's original vision. You combine technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach and enjoy working at the intersection of design, engineering and manufacturing. We’re looking for a Commercial Enablement Manager to drive commercial readiness and effectiveness across Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, and our partner network. Using data, customer insight and market intelligence, you’ll shape our enablement strategy to strengthen our value proposition, focus on the right opportunities and drive measurable revenue growth.

Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations (RevOps), you’ll join our newly established Revenue Operations & Commercial Strategy team, alongside Business Intelligence, Marketing Automation & AI, and Product Marketing. Together, we own the commercial revenue engine across Sales and Marketing.

Your focus will be turning insight into action to improve pipeline, conversion, retention and cross-sell. You’ll play a key role in our 2027 priorities, including ABM in priority sectors, growth in DACH and the Nordics, partnerships and portfolio cross-sell.

We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).

**About Us

**Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.

Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.

Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.

The Role

As our Commercial Enablement Manager, you’ll own the commercial enablement strategy and execution, roadmap and performance across Cookie Information, Piwik PRO and Sheltr. Through combining strategic direction with data-driven decision-making, you’ll equip our teams and partners to turn commercial opportunities into results.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Align programmes, content and priorities with commercial objectives, product strategy and brand positioning across all three brands.

• Partner with BI and RevOps to analyse CRM, pipeline, win/loss, sales conversation and customer data, identify performance gaps and measure revenue impact.

• Develop account- and sector-specific playbooks, messaging, competitive positioning, objection handling and customer proof points across the buying and renewal journey.

• Lead our commercial events strategy by setting objectives and target-account strategies for conferences, executive events and partner events, and measuring their impact on pipeline and customer relationships in collaboration with our events agency.

• Turn insights from Sales, CS, customers and partners into actionable improvements for Marketing, Product and RevOps.

• Own partner enablement by shaping partner onboarding, certification, train-the-trainer programmes, co-branded resources and sector initiatives that help agency and reseller partners sell our portfolio independently.

• Support launches, new propositions and priority segments, measuring adoption, knowledge and field effectiveness to continuously improve enablement.

• Equip customer-facing teams and partners to communicate our value in marketing analytics, privacy-first data and compliance.

**About You

**You’re a strategic, data-driven commercial thinker who turns customer insight and business performance into practical action. You understand that effective enablement is about driving measurable improvements, not simply producing more content or training. You’re comfortable setting direction, influencing stakeholders and owning outcomes, while staying close to what customer-facing teams need to succeed.

You bring:

• A commercial and data-driven mindset where you use data to set priorities, identify performance gaps and demonstrate the business impact of your work.

• Customer-centricity with the ability to turn feedback from Sales, Customer Success, customers and partners into improvements in messaging, processes and commercial effectiveness.

• Events expertise through your experiences shaping conferences, executive events or partner events around clear commercial objectives and measurable outcomes.

• Stakeholder leadership through cross-functional team alignment, influence without direct authority and coordination of internal stakeholders and external agencies towards shared goals.

• The ability to simplify complex topics, communicate a compelling value proposition and lead effective presentations and train-the-trainer programmes.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience with Piwik PRO or other web analytics platforms, such as GA4, Adobe Analytics or Matomo.

• Knowledge of GDPR/ePrivacy, consent management and data governance, or experience selling into regulated sectors such as healthcare, finance, energy and the public sector.

• Experience enabling agency partners in regulated markets, including US healthcare.

• Experience supporting multi-brand portfolios, cross-sell motions and commercial teams across European markets.

• Familiarity with enablement platforms such as Highspot, Seismic or Showpad, and conversation intelligence tools such as Gong.

• Knowledge of German, French or a Nordic language.

What we offer

• A compelling product and market opportunity helping us turn growing demand for privacy-first analytics and trusted data solutions into commercial growth.

• Ownership and impact potential where you can come and build our enablement strategy and shape how we sell across three brands and multiple European markets.

• Strategic breadth by connecting data-driven ABM, sector strategy, partner development, customer engagement and high-impact events.

• A voice in the business working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Marketing and RevOps to influence how we go to market.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process
